headline: Stlican Shelf Battles Intensify as Northern Front Exchanges Continue
war_summary: Since our previous dispatch, territorial combat has concentrated heavily in Stlican Shelf, where ten strategic base transfers occurred over the past two hours amidst contested fighting across The Pale House, Vulpine Watch, and The Old Mourn. Callahan's Passage remains an active flashpoint, logging three base exchanges in the last two hours at The Latch and The Procession alongside over seven hundred combined casualties. By contrast, frontline ownership has held steady over the last two hours across Fisherman's Row, Marban Hollow, and Weathered Expanse, where earlier base turnover has subsided into localized attrition. Elsewhere, heavy casualties persist along the central lines without immediate base captures; Dead Lands and Weathered Expanse both registered accelerating loss rates in the latest hour, while Stonecradle and Linn of Mercy continue to absorb steady pressure across their disputed sectors.
